name: create_new_case
description: Verify new critical case 1233 was created for Acme Systems on the specified product.

validation_config.query: SELECT count(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND account_id = 3 AND product_id = 48 AND priority = 'critical';

name: update_installed_product_details
description: Verify the installed product associated with the critical case has been put into 'repair' status.

validation_config.query: SELECT status FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 14;

name: set_case_assignment_group
description: Verify case 1233 is assigned to the CSM Tier 1 Support group (ID 1).

validation_config.query: SELECT assignment_group_id FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233;

name: assign_case_to_user
description: Verify case 1233 is assigned to Stephanie Todd (ID 6).

validation_config.query: SELECT assigned_to FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233;

name: link_new_case_sla
description: Verify the Critical Resolution SLA (ID 6) is linked to the new case.

validation_config.query: SELECT count(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 1233 AND sla_def_id = 6;

name: link_new_case_sla
description: Verify the SLA associated with the case is actively 'in_progress'.

validation_config.query: SELECT stage FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 1233 AND sla_def_id = 6;

name: update_installed_product_details
description: Verify the installed_product table's system update time was modified after changing the status.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(sys_updated_on) FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 14 AND status = 'repair' AND sys_updated_on IS NOT NULL;

name: create_new_case
description: Verify the case channel reflects the alert channel prescribed in the prompt.

validation_config.query: SELECT channel FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233;

name: register_new_interaction
description: Verify an interaction record exists related to the newly created case.

validation_config.query: SELECT count(*) FROM interaction WHERE case_id = 1233;

name: register_new_interaction
description: Verify the interaction accurately reflects the handling status.

validation_config.query: SELECT status FROM interaction WHERE interaction_id = 1233;
